key_insights: BTC closed monthly at range midpoint (43.47k) - not bearish but shows waning momentum
Market described as 'awkwardly bullish' - bullish due to breakout but concerned about slow 4-6% progress
Positive news (equities rally, Saylor buying BTC, Terra LFG buying BTC) hasn't translated to strong price action
47k resistance is the immediate hurdle for continuation; 44k is the do-or-die support level
A close above 47k would likely trigger move toward 52k with potential to 56-58k
summary: BTC is in an 'awkwardly bullish' state after breaking out of a 2-month consolidation at the range midpoint around 43.5k. Despite positive fundamental catalysts including equity strength and institutional BTC buying, price action has been slow with only 4-6% upside. The immediate resistance at 47k is critical for continuation toward 52-58k, while 44k serves as the key support level where the breakout thesis would be invalidated.
